summary: Iteration 110 — e2e web + backend verification of the 4 shipped items. 17/17 pytest PASS + full UI proof captured. ITEM 1 (News Radio /radio/news audio regression): GET /api/news_radio/queue?limit=6 → 200 body mode='audio', audio_coverage 6/6, tts.status='active', tts_enabled=true, every item has a real audio_url (/api/static/news_clips/*.mp3), news_audio_voice_id populated. Web UI shows the '🔊 LISTEN · shared for 48h' badge (data-testid=news-radio-audio-badge), a working <audio> player (0:21 duration on the first article), and up-next items rendered with speaker icons. ITEM 2 (Admin anchor-voice picker): GET /api/news_radio/voices returns exactly 5 voices (Raghav/Sarah/George/Roger/Charlie) + current selection. UI: as ADMIN the picker (data-testid=news-radio-voice-picker + select data-testid=news-radio-voice-select) IS visible; as DEMO USER and ANON it is ABSENT. Changing the select POSTs /api/admin/news-radio/voice, the 'Regenerating clips…' status label appears next to the select, and GET /api/news_radio/voices reflects the new current_voice_id. Backend gate: non-admin+anon POST → 401/403; unknown voice_id → 400 {error:unknown_voice}. ITEM 3 (Owner artwork history + revert): GET /api/imported-stations/imp_96063f25060111e8ae/artwork/history returns {ok, current, current_source, history:[{url,source,archived_at}]}. Non-owner user → 403. On the station page as admin, owner-artwork-manager renders with owner-art-generate + a 'RECENT ARTWORK · TAP TO REVERT' strip (data-testid=owner-art-history) containing owner-art-history-0 thumbnail. Clicking the thumbnail → POST /api/imported-stations/{sid}/artwork/restore → 200, toast 'Reverted to previous artwork' shown, thumbnail visually annotated with revert icon. POST restore with unknown url → 400 {error:unknown_art_url}. ITEM 4 (Genre-tagged demo catalog): POST /api/radio/start returns a playable segment (segment_url + track_id + duration_sec) for bollywood_mehfil, punjabi_beats, devotional_hour, and dfw_bollywood_drive. vip_lounge correctly returns a gated response (as designed). No regressions found.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the option label includes a styled span. Non-blocking but should be flattened to plain text to silence the console warning.

action_items: (Nit) Remove the nested <span> inside <option> in the anchor-voice picker (frontend/src/NewsRadio.jsx around the select's <option>) to silence a React hydration warning; no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/news_radio.py:66 /queue still sorts by pubDate without a compound index hint on {summary_script,pubDate desc}. Fine today but revisit under load.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py: no size/dedupe check for artwork_history — if generation returns the exact same URL (image_gen dedupe), _archive_current_art correctly skips the duplicate via the pre-append filter, but a stale entry with `source=='ai'` and current==entry.url is possible if the same URL is later restored + re-archived. Not observed in practice; cosmetic.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:265 restore returns HTTPException detail dict {error:unknown_art_url} — consistent with other endpoints, good. Response wrapping via FastAPI puts it under 'detail' — clients need to read `.detail.error` (verified in tests).

backend/services/news_radio_settings.py:52 set_anchor_voice invalidates ALL cached news_audio_url rows by setting news_audio_expires_at=EPOCH — this is correct for freshness but forces a full batch re-render (5 clips × ~2-3s TTS each) on next request. Consider throttling admin voice-changes to prevent quota burn during A/B testing.
